content.test_md_blob:
# Load portfolio performance with the 1M default selection

> Prove the overview opens with the supported time-range options visible, 1M active by default, and the required chart structure present.

## Step 1

Open {{portfolio_overview_url}} in a browser and wait for the Portfolio Overview workspace to finish loading with the Portfolio Performance card visible.

## Step 2

On first load of the Portfolio Overview workspace, inspect the time-range segmented control in the header.

## Step 3

Assert the control shows 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD, 1Y, and ALL, with 1M as the only active value.

## Step 4

Inspect the Portfolio Performance chart and confirm it shows a portfolio line, a benchmark line, a horizontal grid, an x-axis, a y-axis, and a portfolio area fill.

## Step 5

Hover a visible chart point once to confirm the chart uses its custom tooltip treatment rather than a default browser or graph-library tooltip.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-15, ac-16, ac-17, ac-18, ac-19, ac-20, ac-21, ac-22, ac-23, ac-24

Confirm absolute check: 1M (equals) — the stated promise: The default active time range is 1M.
